title: Meng Zhang
description: Meng Zhang is an Assistant Professor at the ZJU-UIUC Institute, Zhejiang University. His research spans wireless and computer networks, optimization for intelligent networks, edge intelligence, and decentralized machine learning, with emphasis on network economics, mechanism design, and the age of information.
keywords: wireless networks, intelligent networks, edge intelligence, decentralized machine learning, network economics, mechanism design, age of information
